thought.text: Token dan header sudah lengkap, tapi masih 403. Kemungkinan `X-UI-APP` harus persis nilai yang dipakai app. Saya cari nilainya di bundle.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
import re
s=open('/tmp/main.js',errors='ignore').read()
for m in list(re.finditer(r'APP_NAME\s*=',s))[:3]:
    print(re.sub(r'\s+',' ',s[max(0,m.start()-200):m.start()+250]),"\n")
for m in list(re.finditer(r'APP_VERSION\s*=',s))[:2]:
    print(re.sub(r'\s+',' ',s[max(0,m.start()-120):m.start()+150]),"\n")
PY
